description: Import media and lay it into a sequence.

identity.goal: Complete the import and sequence use case of filmcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the filmcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `filmcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced filmcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `filmcraft_media_import`, `filmcraft_project_inspect`, `filmcraft_sequence_inspect`. Steps: (1) Import the media files. (2) Inspect the project tree. (3) Inspect the active sequence. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace filmcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently

never: expose a credential or a secret value

outputs: a summary of each action taken and its result
